nom: La Roche-Posay Effaclar Clarifying Clay Face Mask for Oily Skin

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin most often report reduced shine and a mattified, oil-controlled feel after use, though several say it does not eliminate oiliness completely and one describes it as drying enough to trigger rebound oiliness.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin generally describe the mask as gentle and non-irritating, but one reports redness, heat and burning when left on for the recommended time.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin describe the mask as balancing and not overly stripping, though one finds it does nothing for her pores.
segments.dry: One reviewer with dry skin, describing a separate sunscreen-serum product rather than the mask, reports it feels moisturizing and non-drying.

concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers report reduced shine, oil control, or a mattified feel, especially in the T-zone; a few say it does not noticeably reduce oil, and one with very oily skin reports it left her skin more oily afterward.
concerns.blemishes: Some reviewers link the mask to fewer breakouts, reduced pore congestion, and clearer-looking skin over time; one reviewer reports it caused new blemishes and whiteheads the next day.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the mask blurs acne-related redness and another notices reduced redness after weekly use, but one reviewer reports the mask itself causes redness and burning on application.
concerns.spots: One reviewer notes the mask helps unclog pores and minimize small white bumps under the skin's surface.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer highlights the mask does not dry out or crack the skin, describing it as gentle and non-drying compared with other clay masks.
concerns.aging: No reviews in this set specifically address aging concerns for the mask.

aspects.libelle: Leaves skin soft and smooth after rinsing
Burning or heat sensation on application
High price for amount of product
Thin consistency, product runs out fast
Easy to apply and rinse off

extraits.texte: This doesn't work for people with extremely oily skin like myself. This dried me out so much that my skin became more oily than normal

I really wanted to like this mask. It makes my skin feel so soft after but i can not use it. It says to keep it on for 5 mins but i can not leave it on more than 2 mins. My skin gets red and really hot, even burns.

Didnt really notice much of a difference, and skin still looked dull. My skin is oily and sensitive. I am not a big fan of this product and will probably try a different one. The consistency is also so thin, and the amount of product is too less. I would not buy again
Great product, definitely removes oils. I have combo skin and dont find it too stripping. Dont find it does anything for my pores

This is a very gentle, clay mask that doesn't burn or crack on the skin. I usually apply the mask after a shower, leave on for 5 minutes and use a cloth to remove. My skin feels deeply cleansed, soft and acne redness is blurred.

This is my favourite mask to use when I feel like my skin needs some rescue fast! It clears out my pores amazingly! It makes my skin look shine free for days! Its perfect to use just before doing makeup! Ive recommended this product to a lot of customers and they all love it. Its perfect for sensitive oily skin! It works just as good as the origins 10 min rescue mask without the chemical scent and and half the cost!
Helps unclog pore and minimizes the size of my pores. I have a lot of little white bumps under the surface of my skin and this helps with that
